PRIDE: 'CAL 27 cells grown in regular media were treated with curcumin at a dose of 11.5 uM for 4h and cells cultured in SILAC media were treated with DMSO ... Equal amount of protein lysate from both the conditions was mixed'. One curcumin-treated culture and one DMSO-treated culture, mixed once, fractionated into 12 fractions; each source name denotes one physical lysate.

claims.location: comment[label] + characteristics[treatment] + factor value[treatment] + characteristics[compound] rows 1-6 (SILAC light)
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: curcumin-treated cells were grown 'in regular media' (= light); MSF quantification method 'SILAC 2plex (Arg6, Lys6)': channel 1 Light = no label, channel 2 Heavy = Label:13C(6) K and R, ratio reported Light/Heavy. Same-lab sister study (PMC4908701, PXD002097): 'cells grown in light medium were treated with curcumin for 4 h and the cells grown in heavy medium were treated with vehicle (DMSO)'. Data check: Deposited MSF (sha1 278500a3... = PRIDE checksum) re-analysed with scripts/orient.py (full output orient_full.txt). Every in-scope FileID (01_R, 04, 05, 06, 11, 12) carries confident rank-1 PSMs with the 13C6 K/R label (427-717 per file) and 638-1153 phosphoPSMs with both Light and Heavy areas, i.e. all six runs are genuine 2-plex SILAC mixtures. PD ratio is Light/Heavy. Collapsed to unique phosphopeptide sequences over all searched files and median-normalised (global median L/H 1.119): 220 with L/H >= 2 and 341 with L/H <= 0.5. The deposit abstract reports 275 hyper- and 335 hypo-phosphorylated phosphopeptides (>=2-fold) upon curcumin; light = curcumin reproduces the hypo>hyper asymmetry (220/341 vs 275/335), the swapped assignment would invert it (341 hyper / 220 hypo). Consistent with the explicit PRIDE channel statement; the check is supportive, not independent proof (the authors' exact filtering, phosphoRS cut-off and normalisation are not deposited).

limitations: PARTIAL SCOPE: 7 of 13 deposited raws excluded - CAL27_Curcumin_2SILAC_pST_1.raw, _02.raw, _03.raw, _07.raw, _08.raw, _09.raw, _10.raw. They are not the files the deposited search processed (sizes differ from MSF FileInfos), embed other original names (HNSCC_CAL27_Phospho_5/2/3/7/8/9/10.raw), use another instrument method (90min_pSTY_MIPS_HCD, top10, MS1 350-1800) and were acquired 2013-10-16/23, two months before the in-scope Dec 2013 series. Their sample identity, labelling and whether they belong to this curcumin experiment at all are undocumented; recorded in BLOCKED.md. The MSF-searched files CAL27_Curcumin_2SILAC_pST_01, 02, 03, 07, 08, 09, 10 are therefore missing from the deposit.

No publication found: PRIDE's reference (Solanki HS et al., Mitochondrion 2018, cigarette smoke in lung cells) belongs to PXD007108 and is not this study; Europe PMC search for the accession and for the title returned nothing. All sample metadata comes from the PRIDE protocol text, the MSF and raw headers; the same-lab pTyr paper (PMC4908701 / PXD002097) is used only to corroborate the channel map.
PRIDE protocol text describes an 'LTQ-Orbitrap Fusion' with 120K/15K resolution, top10 and 35% NCE; the raw files are LTQ Orbitrap Velos, HCD 39 NCE, top15 (in scope). Raw-header values were used.
